paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-1 evaluation.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “QA-1” illustrates the performance of three Korean-language large language models—Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our)—on a financial question-answering evaluation, with results segmented into three categories: Correct (dark purple), Partially Correct (medium blue), and Incorrect (light blue), as indicated by the legend below. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of responses falling into each category, ranging from 0 to 1, while the vertical axis lists the models. For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the bar is divided into 0.88 (Correct), 0.08 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect). Both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our) show identical performance: 0.96 (Correct), 0 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect), with no partially correct responses. The chart visually emphasizes that RedWhale and EEVE-Korean achieve higher correctness rates than Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, with RedWhale matching EEVE-Korean’s top performance while being highlighted as “our” model.
